chapter.heading: Colossians 3
Put On the New Self
chapter.v: 3 If then you have been raised with Christ, seekthe things that are above, where Christ is,seated at the right hand of God.
Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth.
you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ who is your lifeappears, then you also will appear with himin glory.
Put to death thereforewhat is earthly in you:sexual immorality, impurity,passion, evil desire, and covetousness,which is idolatry.
On account of these the wrath of God is coming.
In these you too once walked, when you were living in them.
But now you must put them all away:anger, wrath, malice,slander, and obscene talk from your mouth.
Do not lie to one another, seeing thatyou have put offthe old self with its practices
and have put onthe new self,which is being renewed in knowledgeafter the image ofits creator.
all, and in all.
humility, meekness, and patience,
as the Lord has forgiven you, so you also must forgive.
perfect harmony.
be thankful.
with thankfulness in your hearts to God.
giving thanks to God the Father through him.
is fitting in the Lord.
do not be harsh with them.
in everything, for this pleases the Lord.

in everything those who are your earthly masters, not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
as for the Lord and not for men,
